options.content:
## Catalyst Replica Freshness — three propagation hops

This dashboard watches the Linear/GitHub mirror replication path end to end. There is **no Prometheus pipeline for `catalyst-cloud`** — every cloud panel is **Loki aggregation-over-time** (`count_over_time` / `max_over_time`), never `rate()`/`increase()`. All cloud fields live in the **JSON body** (`source`, `headSeq`, `receivedAt`, `deduped`) — extracted with `regexp` + `unwrap`, **never `| json`**.

- **Cloud ingest freshness** (top row) — `catalyst.mirror.ingest.committed` (CTC-144) is the terminal cloud commit. Ingest rate, time-since-last-commit, and the `headSeq` watermark per source. *Silent-drop* tracks `deduped:true` — any non-zero is a silently-dropped delivery (CTC-139-class).
- **Local Linear staleness** (middle row) — `service_name="catalyst.cloud-sync"` line `cloud-sync: freshness` carries `catalyst.linear.replica.{staleness,cursor}` per node (**Linear only; mini/mini-2 only** — dev nodes ship nothing). Staleness is already an **age in ms** so its thresholds color correctly.
- **Cloud-vs-node lag** (HEADLINE) — `cloud.headSeq(linear)` − `node.cursor(linear)` per node. **No single LogQL can subtract across two stream selectors** — built as a Grafana math expression ($B − $A) combining the cloud-headSeq query and the per-node cursor query.

**Gap panels** (orange-titled) light up only when their producer ships: per-update apply latency = **CTL-1402** (`catalyst.replica.apply` with `applied_at`/`received_at`); GitHub local-replica freshness has **no producer** yet (emitted nowhere).

panels.title: Cloud ingest rate by source
panels.description: CTC-144 catalyst.mirror.ingest.committed terminal commits per source over time. Loki count_over_time — no Prometheus pipeline for catalyst-cloud. Verified live: github=54, linear=26 events/1h.

panels.title: Time since last cloud ingest (per source)
panels.description: Latest receivedAt epoch-ms per source, rendered as age via the dateTimeFromNow unit. NOTE: LogQL has no now()/time() in metric queries, so threshold COLORING operates on raw epoch-ms (not age) and will not light meaningfully — pair this with the node-staleness stat (panel 6) for true age coloring. Verified: github age ~13m, linear age ~2.7m.

targets.expr: max by (src)(max_over_time({service_namespace="catalyst-cloud"} |= "ingest.committed" | regexp `"source":"(?P<src>[a-z_]+)"` | regexp `"receivedAt":(?P<ra>[0-9]+)` | unwrap ra [1h]))

panels.title: Cloud head watermark (headSeq) by source
panels.description: Monotonic head-sequence watermark per source — the cloud-side commit cursor. Verified: github=327008, linear=327132 (linear matches live head ~327073-327132). Named-group regexp anchors on the literal 'headSeq' key so there is no digit collision with the adjacent receivedAt epoch.

targets.expr: max by (src)(max_over_time({service_namespace="catalyst-cloud"} |= "ingest.committed" | regexp `"source":"(?P<src>[a-z_]+)"` | regexp `"headSeq":(?P<hs>[0-9]+)` | unwrap hs [1h]))

panels.title: Silent-drop rate (deduped=true) by source
panels.description: CTC-139-class signal: ingest.committed with deduped:true = a silently-dropped delivery. Verified currently 0 for all sources (committed total 81 = deduped:false github 54 + linear 27). Any non-zero here is a real drop.

panels.title: Local Linear replica staleness per node
panels.description: Node-self-reported Linear replica staleness (catalyst.linear.replica.staleness, ms) from cloud-sync: freshness. Already an age in ms so thresholds color correctly. Verified: mini avg 7426ms, mini-2 avg 7436ms; laptop absent (dev node ships nothing). Linear only; mini/mini-2 only.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({service_name="catalyst.cloud-sync", host_name=~"$node"} |= "cloud-sync: freshness" | regexp `"catalyst.linear.replica.staleness":(?P<s>[0-9]+)` | unwrap s [1m]) by (host_name)

panels.title: Node Linear replica cursor per node
panels.description: Per-node Linear replica cursor (catalyst.linear.replica.cursor) — same Linear seq space as cloud headSeq. Monotonic; last_over_time so a reduction shows the newest cursor. Verified: mini=327134, mini-2=327134 (both caught up to head).

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name="catalyst.cloud-sync", host_name=~"$node"} |= "cloud-sync: freshness" | regexp `"catalyst.linear.replica.cursor":(?P<c>[0-9]+)` | unwrap c [2m]) by (host_name)

panels.title: Cloud-vs-node Linear lag (head behind) — HEADLINE
panels.description: Lag = cloud headSeq(linear) − node cursor(linear), per node. NO single LogQL subtracts across two stream selectors — built as a Grafana math expression $B − $A (A = per-node cursor, B = scalar cloud head). Verified inputs: head=327132, cursor mini/mini-2=327134 → ~0 now (caught up). Brief negatives are expected when the cloud head window trails the per-node last cursor.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name="catalyst.cloud-sync", host_name=~"$node"} |= "cloud-sync: freshness" | regexp `"catalyst.linear.replica.cursor":(?P<c>[0-9]+)` | unwrap c [10m]) by (host_name)

panels.title: Cloud-vs-node Linear lag over time
panels.description: Range variant of the headline: B (scalar cloud head, [5m] window) − A (per-node cursor) plotted per node. Verified range inputs: cursor returns mini+mini-2, head scalar=327132.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name="catalyst.cloud-sync", host_name=~"$node"} |= "cloud-sync: freshness" | regexp `"catalyst.linear.replica.cursor":(?P<c>[0-9]+)` | unwrap c [2m]) by (host_name)

panels.title: ⚠ GAP — Per-update cloud→node apply latency (CTL-1402)
panels.description: GAP: lights up when CTL-1402 emits catalyst.replica.apply carrying applied_at + received_at + delivery_id. Latency = applied_at − received_at. Verified empty today (count_over_time replica.apply [24h] = 0). Confirm field names against the emitted body before trusting the unwrap; the self-contained inline received_at shape is preferred over a cross-stream delivery_id join.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="catalyst.cloud-sync", host_name=~"$node"} |= "replica.apply" | regexp `"applied_at":(?P<aa>[0-9]+)` | regexp `"received_at":(?P<ra>[0-9]+)` | unwrap (aa - ra) [$__range]) by (host_name)

panels.title: ⚠ GAP — GitHub local-replica freshness per node
panels.description: GAP: GitHub replica freshness is emitted NOWHERE today (cloud-sync: freshness carries Linear only). This panel is a placeholder for when a GitHub-local freshness signal lands (mirrors the Linear staleness shape). Until then it returns no series.

targets.expr: max by (host_name)(max_over_time({service_name="catalyst.cloud-sync", host_name=~"$node"} |= "cloud-sync: freshness" | regexp `"catalyst.github.replica.staleness":(?P<s>[0-9]+)` | unwrap s [10m]))
